This is an invalid file type for testing.
Text files (.txt) should be rejected by the upload validator.
Only PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPG, JPEG, PNG, and ZIP files are allowed.

This file is used to test the file type validation in:
- FileUploadWithPreview component
- Upload API endpoint (/api/upload)

Expected behavior: Upload should fail with error message about unsupported file type.
